boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 146 runs dual top counters — `20` and `17` — that tick down as scraps clear from a Lego-textured grid. A sealed left yellow column and a red star-dotted anchor pin the lower half. The star-dotted block must break before the final purple 2×2 can exit, but shifting the green L-piece too early blocks the center lane and strands the anchor.
landmarks: Block Out Level 146 runs dual top counters — `20` and `17` — that tick down as scraps clear from a Lego-textured grid.
A sealed left yellow column and a red star-dotted anchor pin the lower half.
The star-dotted block must break before the final purple 2×2 can exit, but shifting the green L-piece too early blocks the center lane and strands the anchor.

quickTips: Break the red star-dotted block before sliding the center purple 2×2.
Keep the purple 12 cluster intact until the top counters drop below 15.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the left yellow column down with the side green up-arrow to start spending the top 20 counter without shifting the purple 12 pair.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Break the twin top 20/17 tiles down to 15/12 by clearing the upper cyan 5 and red scraps between them.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Route the blue L-shape and red 2×2 through the center gap once the counters hit 15/12.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the bottom purple 12 cluster and yellow 8 tile to drop the top frames to 6/3.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Break the red star-dotted block on the bottom-right before sliding the center purple 2×2.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Spend the final 6/3 counters on the green L-piece and last blue scraps for the board clear.

failurePoints: Sliding the purple 2×2 before the red star-dotted block breaks, sealing the bottom red lane.
Shifting the purple 12 cluster while the top 20 counter is still full, wasting the first spend.
